target.title: fix(slack): log native progress stream start failures instead of silently swallowing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When native Slack progress streaming starts, overlapping progress callbacks can await the same in-flight `startSlackStream` promise. The **initiating** `updateNativeProgressStream()` path already reports failures via `runtime.error`, but the prior PR added a second `logVerbose` in the waiter catch — duplicating diagnostics for one rejection.

## Changes

- **Remove duplicate waiter logging** — `waitForNativeProgressStreamStart()` keeps a silent catch that only marks `streamFailed` and returns `false`.
- **Improve single-owner diagnostic** — initiating `updateNativeProgressStream()` now reports `start` vs `update` phase in the existing `runtime.error` message.
- **Add production-equivalent overlap regression** — uses the real `createChannelProgressDraftGate` with staggered overlapping progress callbacks; asserts exactly **one** `runtime.error` and **no** waiter `logVerbose` duplicate.

## Evidence

**Current head:** `94aad230`

**L3 live Slack (redacted):** public channel; overlapping native progress start against real `chat.startStream`; Slack rejected with `missing_recipient_user_id`; exactly **one** start-phase `runtime.error`; waiter added **no** duplicate verbose log; normal `chat.postMessage` fallback succeeded in the same thread.

```text
[live] anchor posted (ids redacted)
[runtime.error] slack-stream: native progress stream start failed: An API error occurred: missing_recipient_user_id; code: slack_webapi_platform_error; slack error: missing_recipient_user_id; scopes: [redacted]; accepted: chat:write, falling back
{
  "scenario": "live Slack: overlapping native progress start → one start-phase runtime.error → chat.postMessage fallback",
  "observedSlackStartError": "missing_recipient_user_id",
  "runtimeErrorCount": 1,
  "runtimeErrorPhase": "start",
  "waiterDuplicateVerboseLog": false,
  "fallbackPostMessageOk": true,
  "channelKind": "public",
  "privateData": "redacted"
}
```

**Regression tests (unit, production gate):**
```
pnpm exec vitest run extensions/slack/src/monitor/message-handler/dispatch.preview-fallback.test.ts   -t "native Slack progress start fails|overlapping native progress"
→ 2 passed
```

**Notes:** Proof script lives only under gitignored `.local/` (not committed). Tokens/channel/user/team ids omitted from this body.

## Review

- ClawSweeper Rank-up: live start-phase error + fallback proof attached; single error owner preserved
- AI-assisted: Yes
